title: Renderflow standalone screenplay PDF bundle v1
description: Completion receipt published last in a new output directory after explicit opt-in screenplay PDF generation. Retain all three listed artifacts and bundle.json together.
$comment: Completed means these bundle members were published, not runtime qualification, source-text equivalence, visual fidelity, or reproducibility. Consumers must verify file existence, byte lengths and hashes; validate analysis.json and provider-evidence.json against their dedicated schemas; and bind screenplay.pdf to the provider output and nested PDF inspection digests. JSON Schema cannot establish publication order or verify file bytes.

limits.const: PDF structure and the restricted source profile are independently inspected. Visual fidelity, font substitution, pagination stability, and byte reproducibility remain unqualified.
